title: Designing Shape with abstraction and polymorphism
answer: Define a common abstraction such as an abstract Shape class or Shape interface with an area() operation, then let Circle and Square implement that operation. Client code accepts Shape references and calls area() without branching on concrete types. Runtime polymorphism selects each implementation, so adding another shape does not require rewriting the area-calculation client.
